question: to the Commission Raffaele Topo (S&D), Georgia Tramacere (S&D), Sandro Ruotolo (S&D), Lucia Annunziata (S&D), Giuseppe Lupo (S&D) Subject:
State of play of the EU authorisation procedure for concessions from social security contributions for large companies in Southern Italy (Italian Law No 207/2024).

Italian Law No 207/2024 (Article 1, paragraphs 413-4211) provides a system of concessions from social security contributions for businesses in Southern Italy. In the case of larger undertakings, the measure will only come into effect once the Commission has given its authorisation pursuant to Article 108(3) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). The lack of information about this procedure continues to generate great uncertainty among countless businesses and employers in Southern Italy. This includes accredited health and social care bodies that perform essential services in the public interest. In the light of the foregoing, can the Commission say: 1.
What is the state of play regarding the Article 108 TFEU assessment procedure? Please include the relevant case number.
Have the Italian authorities been sent any comments or requests for further information, and how much longer is the procedure expected to take?

(25 August 2026) The Commission has not received any notification from the Italian authorities regarding concessions from social security contributions for large enterprises in Southern Italy Italian on the basis of Law No 207/2024. In accordance with Article 108(3) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU, it is for Member States to notify state aid measures to the Commission prior to their implementation. Depending on the design of the measure, it may potentially fall under the Regional Aid Guidelines (1) or even the General Block Exemption Regulation (2), provided it meets the relevant conditions.
